title: Degen-Trade
description:
A trading competition platform using blockchain technology can address several problems in the financial and trading industry. Here are some potential issues that such a platform could solve: Transparency and Immutability, Security, Fairness and Integrity, Real-time Settlements, Global Accessibility, Ownership of Assets
